name: Helen Pringle

residences.note: Same address as her sister Florence in 1926

bioAdditions: FamilySearch records Helen R. Pringle's marriage at Wilkes-Barre on 16 Sep 1931 to William J. Toole (1905-1976). At the time she lived at 28 Huston Street, the address her sister Florence gave at her own 1926 marriage. FamilySearch places the Tooles at Marion, Ohio, in 1940 and gives Helen's death date as 13 Apr 1992 (S1). Her younger sister Katherine married a Daniel F. Toole.

sources.citation: FamilySearch published tree, Helen Pringle (LHC3-KMF), with attached index entries
